core.description: Core — a KeysProvider hears every key on the page, keeps the Keys, and calls every Enabled useKeys; it Takes the keys of the Shortcuts and Sequences declared in it and refuses those that Conflict.
key names one Key; key-input listens to the page and keeps the Kept Keys from it; keymap matches keys to declared Shortcuts and Sequences; provider puts them together for React.

recognizers.description: Recognizers — the hooks an app calls: useShortcut and useSequence, each declaring its keys to the nearest KeysProvider. They never know about each other.
Each Recognizer declares its keys through the provider on its own.

use-keys.description: Recognizers are built on the core; the core never imports them. Each layer is its own entry point.
